name: Ephlal
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Ephlal was a descendant of Judah through the Jerahmeel line. He is mentioned in Chronicles as the son of Shobal and father of Obed. He is part of a genealogical line that connects the tribe of Judah across several generations.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jerahmeel's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Ephlal is mentioned as the son of Shobal and father of Obed in the genealogy of Jerahmeel, a descendant of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Genealogy of the Tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Ephlal is included in the detailed genealogical record in 1 Chronicles that links the descendants of Judah through the line of Jerahmeel.

keyEvents.title: Father of Obed
keyEvents.description: Ephlal became the father of Obed, thus continuing the family line of Jerahmeel within the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Family Line from Jerahmeel
keyEvents.description: Eflal belongs to the long lineage that begins with Jerahmeel, Ram's brother, and extends through many generations in the tribe of Judah.
